prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production-ready raster background illustration for the hero of an English university course website called Modern AI. Wide landscape composition, roughly 2:1. The established visual identity is minimalist Swiss editorial, white #ffffff, graphite #1a1a1a and restrained acid lime #bef264. Subject: an elegant abstract mathematical sculpture evoking a neural network and latent space, fine graphite filaments sweeping through a layered curved mesh, a few precise lime nodes, subtle 3D depth and a very light soft shadow. It should feel like a contemporary scientific editorial illustration, sophisticated and tactile, not a literal labeled diagram. Layout is crucial: left 52% of the image is clean pure white negative space for large black title and subtitle; artwork occupies the right half, mainly right center, with graceful cropped edges and generous breathing room. Bottom 15% softly fades back to pure white for metadata. Use thin light-gray and graphite lines, no dark filled masses. Background must be pure white, no paper grain. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, robots, brains, people, screens, blue or purple gradients. Quiet and crisp, the image should support readable website copy.
